Kids Bible Class · August — Week 3

God Made Me in His Image

Genesis 1:26-27; Exodus 34:6-7

“How you made me is amazing and wonderful.”

Psalm 139:14 (NIrV)

You are made in God's image — made to be like Him.

Image 1

When God made people, He did something very special.

He said, “Let us make them in our image, to be like us.”

Image 2

Being made in God's image means we can do things like God does.

We can create, imagine, and make beautiful things.

Image 3

God is loving, kind, patient, and forgiving.

Because we are made like Him, we can be loving and kind too.

Image 4

When you share, help, and forgive,

you show other people a little picture of what God is like.

Image 5

You carry something very special inside you —

God's own likeness.

You were made to show His love to the world.

What We Learn

When God made people, He made us in His own image. That means we can love, create, help, and forgive — just like God does. When you are kind and loving, you show others a little picture of what God is like.

For you: You carry God's likeness inside you. So today, you can choose to be kind, patient, and forgiving — and show people how good God is.
